layout.hierarchy: The circular diagram dominates (largest element, center-right, multi-color). Title is next in visual weight (large bold red). Note box and formula box are secondary (small bold colored text in boxes). Slide-number badge is smallest.

visual_elements.description: Circular positional-encoding 'clock' diagram. Pale-yellow filled circle (center ≈ 57% x / 50% y of slide, diameter ≈ 33% of slide width) divided into 12 equal 30° sectors by 12 thin red radial spokes from center to rim. Dashed red horizontal and vertical axis lines pass through the center and extend across the slide (horizontal line runs through Word 6 and Word 0; vertical line runs through Word 3 and Word 9). Twelve small light-green rounded rectangles sit just outside the rim at 30° intervals, each rotated so its long side is tangent to the circle, labeled in green bold italic text: Word 0 at 3 o'clock (0°), Word 1 (30°), Word 2 (60°), Word 3 at 12 o'clock (90°, text vertical), Word 4 (120°), Word 5 (150°), Word 6 at 9 o'clock (180°), Word 7 (210°), Word 8 (240°), Word 9 at 6 o'clock (270°, text vertical), Word 10 (300°), Word 11 (330°) — i.e., indices increase counterclockwise. Thin orange curved arcs with small orange arrowheads connect each word position to the next counterclockwise (Word 0 → Word 1 → … → Word 11 → Word 0), each arc annotated with a bold red '+ω' label (≈10 labels visible; the remainder appear occluded by the word boxes). A black mouse-pointer cursor (video artifact) overlaps the Word 2 box.
Pale-yellow rectangular formula box with three left-aligned lines: 'Sin(ω t)' (blue bold), 'Cos(ω t)' (blue bold), 't=0,1,2,3,....' (green).

White rectangle with ~2px red border and three centered lines: 'Using smaller ω value, allow' / 'representation of longer sequences' (blue bold, with the single word 'smaller' carrying a yellow highlight) and '(practically use  ω = 1/10000)' (red).
Slide-number badge: yellow circle with a dark navy ring containing the number '29' in dark text.
Solid black horizontal bar across the very bottom of the frame (video letterbox artifact, not designed slide content).

imagery: Black mouse-pointer cursor resting on/near the Word 2 box at upper right of the circle — a screen-recording artifact, not designed slide content. No photographs or illustrations otherwise; all graphics are vector shapes (circle, spokes, arcs, boxes, badge).
typography_notes: Entirely sans-serif (Arial/Verdana-like). Title: bold, largest text on slide (~28-32pt), red, three lines with the third line ('as angles') indented right. Formula-box lines: bold ~18pt, blue for Sin/Cos, green for the t-values. Word labels: bold italic ~12pt green. '+ω' arc labels: bold red ~14pt. Note-box text: bold ~14pt, centered, blue with yellow-highlighted word and a red third line. Slide number: plain ~14pt dark text in a yellow circle.
animation_state: Slide appears fully built — no partial bullet reveal or mid-build elements. A static mouse cursor near Word 2 indicates this is a frame from a screen recording.
recreation_brief: 1. Set slide background to light gray #E8E8E8. 2. Add a text box top-left (~3% from left, ~9% from top, ~30% wide) with three lines, Arial bold ~28pt, red #CC0000, left-aligned: 'Sequence of 12 words' / 'Positions are defined' / 'as angles' (indent the third line). 3. Top-right corner: draw a small oval (~0.45in), fill #FFFF00, dark navy outline, text '29' ~14pt dark. 4. Center-right: draw a large circle centered at ~57% x / 50% y, diameter ~4.5in, fill #FFFFCC, thin light outline. 5. Add 12 thin red (#FF8080) radial lines from the circle's center to its rim at 30° increments; also add dashed red horizontal and vertical lines through the center spanning most of the slide (axes through Word 0/Word 6 and Word 3/Word 9). 6. Create 12 rounded rectangles (~0.9in x 0.35in), fill #CCFFCC, outline #339933, each with green #008000 bold italic ~12pt text: 'Word 0' through 'Word 11'. Place them just outside the rim at 0°, 30°, 60°, 90°, 120°, 150°, 180°, 210°, 240°, 270°, 300°, 330° counterclockwise starting at 3 o'clock (Word 0 right, Word 3 top, Word 6 left, Word 9 bottom); rotate each box tangent to the circle so Word 0/Word 6 are horizontal and Word 3/Word 9 are vertical. 7. Draw 12 thin orange #FF6600 curved arcs with small arrowheads connecting consecutive word boxes counterclockwise (Word 0 → Word 1 → … → Word 11 → Word 0); place a bold red '+ω' label (~14pt) beside each arc, matching the ~10 visible label positions in the original. 8. Middle-left (~8% from left, ~31% from top, ~2.2in wide): pale-yellow #FFFFCC rectangle with left-aligned bold lines: 'Sin(ω t)' and 'Cos(ω t)' in blue #0000CC, then 't=0,1,2,3,....' in green #008000. 9. Bottom-left (~6% from left, ~72% from top, ~4.7in wide): white rectangle with a 2pt red #CC0000 border, centered bold ~14pt text: line 1-2 'Using smaller ω value, allow representation of longer sequences' in blue #0000CC with the word 'smaller' highlighted in yellow #FFFF00; line 3 '(practically use  ω = 1/10000)' in red #CC0000. 10. Optional (to mimic the video frame only): add a solid black strip along the bottom edge — this is letterbox artifact, not slide content.
